body: Pre-registered 2026-11-21 (research_notes/Backtests/india_pead_v2.md) before any 2026 statistic was computed. Universe: all 1,870 current NSE EQ/BE equities listed by 2023-12-31 -> 1,555 companies in Rs 400-60,000 cr range; SUE on consolidated basic EPS where its FY2020+ history suffices (79% of fresh events), else standalone; v1 rules otherwise (entry = close of first trading day after the results announcement; Rs 500-50,000 cr; controls = all universe stocks x0.5-x2 mcap, median 374). Fresh = 4,272 events (1,181 cos) of quarters Dec-25, Mar-26, Jun-26 (63d closed) and Sep-26 (pending: 21d closes Dec-2026, 63d ~Feb-2027). Inference event-level, SE clustered by entry week, 5,000-draw cluster bootstrap. H1 top quintile vs controls 63d: gross +2.41% [+0.84, +4.23] t 2.81; NET of 1% +1.41% [-0.14, +3.27] t 1.65 -> NOT PROVEN (near-identical to v1 test +2.36% gross / +1.36% net CI -0.06). H2 filter (announcement-window return > 0): contrast up-minus-down +0.26% [-3.06, +3.37] t 0.16 -> NOT SUPPORTED (v1 exploratory finding did not replicate). H3 bottom quintile 63d -2.73% [-4.41, -1.51] t -3.60 -> SUPPORTED (month-clustered t -2.75, CI still excludes 0). H4 (exploratory): mid tertile was the WEAKEST in 2026 (top vs controls small +4.50%, mid -0.84%, large +4.46%) -> v1 mid-tertile pattern looks like noise. Context: T-B raw 63d +5.14% (t 3.87); ladder Q1..Q5 -2.73, -2.81, -0.15, +1.43, +2.41% (avoid zone = bottom TWO quintiles); top leg positive in all 3 fresh quarters (+0.87, +1.85, +4.47%), bottom negative in all 3. 2022-25 re-run with consolidated EPS: pass B fetch was still running at hand-off -> re-run numbers PENDING (H1 is already not supported because the fresh half failed). Lesson: two independent periods agree - India PEAD is real (T-B ~+4-5%/quarter) but the practical retail edge is the free AVOID leg; the long-only tilt (~+2.4% gross) is not separable from zero after a 1% round trip.
title: PEAD v2 (India, fresh 2026 out-of-sample, full NSE universe, consolidated EPS): avoid-leg confirmed (bottom SUE quintile -2.7% vs size-matched controls at 63d, CI excludes 0); long-only top quintile +2.4% gross but +1.4% net of 1% cost with CI touching zero again - not proven; 'positive announcement reaction' filter fails
